justification: Inspected ui/src/main/java/org/adoptopenjdk/jitwatch/ui/triview/bytecode/ViewerBytecode.java and BytecodeLabel.java. The package contains exactly 2 classes totaling 524 LOC (ViewerBytecode 500 LOC, BytecodeLabel 24 LOC). BytecodeLabel is only a thin wrapper around BytecodeInstruction, and ViewerBytecode is a focused UI viewer for bytecode highlighting/navigation/tooltip rendering rather than a broad package of many responsibilities. There is no evidence of a large class count or package-wide responsibility concentration, so the package does not exhibit a God Component smell.
